reviews.t: All natural ingredients run it under warm water for best results
reviews.x: [[VIDEOID:8c0b8d833491811e1114ca47cd8a4f04]] When I first started growing my beard out it drives me crazy how itchy it gets so someone recommended I use beard balm. When I first received the balm I had trouble getting it to squeeze out of the tube. I contacted the seller and she told me that this is because of the all natural ingredients and all I need to do is run it under warm water. I tried this and it worked out perfectly! I posted this video to be sure people understand this is what happens

like other mentioned, if it’s cold it’s hard to squeeze out of the tube. just run it under lukewarm water for a few seconds and it will come out. it’s massages to liquid in the heat of your hands in seconds anyway and ready for use. honestly see it as a good thing it means they didn’t use a bunch of chemicals and solvents to keep it perfect at all temps. all natural for my all natural beard. smells great and nice conditioning effect. highly recommend

PERFECT! Just Perfect!  For way too long i've used new product after new product that were all just a little too "______" Fill in the blank with whatever you'd like. Too oily, too strong of a scent on your face, too hard to get the scent off your hands afterwards, too much added weight to your beard...the list goes on.  King Manes takes the cake. The all natural ingredients leave a perfect balance to your beard! There is a distinct difference to this product versus the dozens of previously tried
Killer product. I have a monster 2 year beard.  Makes my skin feel really goodalso has done holding power. So far I'm impressed and I've tried everything out there

I am not the type of person who enjoys being negative,  and I do love giving five star ratings, when I can.  If I were able to get the balm out of the tube, I could raise the rating.  I am relatively strong (275 lbs.).  I could not even get a little bit out this morning.  Granted,  our heater has not gotten our indoor temperature much past 60 Degrees.  That maybe contributing to the difficulty.  I have even though of putting in Microwave for a few seconds, but not sure whether that is a good ide

After purchasing different beard oils that were either too expensive or according to my wife, smelled like rotten lemons, this one checks all the boxes.  It feels great on my beard, I love the way it smells (but more importantly so does my wife), and it doesn't fade after half the day.  I was worried it would make my face/beard too oily and make me break out, but quite the opposite has happened with my face feeling moisturized and beard soft as a cloud. Thanks for making a great product that isn

My beard is at most a half inch in length and this balm works wonders! It makes it feel hydrated, soft, healthy, and best of all, makes it naturally thick! If you have a light beard, give it a shot! This is the best stuff I've found yet. It's almost more like a mousse or something. It doesn't leave a greasy or waxy film and it gives my beard a nice smooth and full look and feel. I've tried a few oils and some of that stuff that comes in a shoe shine can and this is exactly what I was looking for.  I am not paid for this review and I paid full price for the product, I only want to give you fellas my honest opinion.

Finally, something that’s natural!! This beard balm is beyond amazing. It feels great on my skin and the minty smell to it really wakes me up in the mornings. I haven’t been able to find something that works and feels as great as this beard bomb so this defiantly gets a thumbs up for me.

reviews.t: Good product after you learn how to get the oil out of the tube
reviews.x: At first I had trouble getting anything at all out of the tube.  There was a problem with my cap that prevented anything from coming out. But after taking the cap off the product flowed out. By reading other reviews I learned that the tube must be submerged in hot water for some time to liquify the mixture of oil. Otherwise you get a pebbly mixture. And unless you live in a subtropical climate, one of the oils in the mixture comes out in a semi-solid state and must be rolled between your palms t

Next, Even if you do heat it, it leaves a SUPER greasy residue on your face and in your beard.  It’s like literally running straight olive oil into your beard.  It’s gross, I’d never use it if I was going out, as if o touch my beard I now need to wash my hands before I can touch my clothes without staining them with grease.  It also feels gross in my beard, very slimy.  As mu

This product was okay. I had a few things I disliked about it though. First off it was a little bit earthy smelling which I’m not a big fan of. Some people are into it, so some may not mind that about this product. However, another issue that I had was that it was gritty it almost felt like I was rubbing an exfoliant scrub into my beard. It left some of the grit in there also. I had to try to brush it all out. I’m sure that there are ingredients in this product that are beneficial, but those few

reviews.t: Made my beard smell like mint.
reviews.x: Stuff smells great but in no way does this balm have any "shaping" or "holding" properties. I have a full beard that can get quite wiry at times as my beard hair is thick. This stuff did nothing but make it shiny and smell like mint (which was a bonus so 2 stars for that).  If you're looking for something to keep your beard looking groomed and in place and have similar beard type to mine, keep looking.

This product is amazing I'm a barber and I have use many other products and this one really got me to it with the results, but the most amazing thing is the fabulous aroma not to strong and masculine, I will highly recomend or it least give it a try you won't regret.  Disclaimer-- ( I got this product to test it I did not purchase it.  But this do not affect in my review the product speaks by it self.)

Hands down the best oil I’ve ever used on my beard. It leaves my beard feeling truly moisturized all day, gives so much control to my wild/unruly beard, smells great and it’s a great value. If it’s stored in a colder temperature, it can be hard to squeeze out. If it’s stored in a hot climate, too much may come out. I won’t use another beard oil after trying this. Highly recommend!

I bought this to keep my beard soft and to promote growth but from all I can tell is that it make it softer. My issue is that depending on the temperature of your home, the consistency of the balm will change. So if it’s below 68 you’ll get a thick gel form if it’s above 68 you’ll get a sloppy shot of goo in your hand and lots of it. A little gritty but smell nice as well.

1st. Product is great for moisturizing beard and skin. Gives beard a nice and lasting sheen. 2nd. Scent has a hint of menthol. Not strong but noticeable. Guessing it is ingredients. Different choice would be nice. 3rd. A little goes a long way. Love that about it. Other products have to be lathered on. Overall real nice. Will purchase again.

I just started my beard....lots of gray so it's very coarse.  This beard balm/oil is fantastic.  It keeps the skin under the beard nice and lubricated and got rid of my dry skin causing flakes....now, just a nice looking beard with no flakes....it makes my skin and beard look great....Make it in a bigger bottle.

Great!! I ordered this product to try and keep my unruly beard under control during my vacation to Bali earlier this year. Well, what a pleasant surprise I got -- usually my beard is frizzy, curly and coarse in the hot heather, But with this beard oil, my beard stayed smooth and sleek. Thanks, King Mane!!

Great procuct and easy to apply. I was very happy it didn’t have a woodsy oil smell just like every other beard oil on the market. Suttle soft smell and it last all day. I would strongly recommend for anyone looking and doneant want the same old beard oil found everywhere.

reviews.t: Great For My Beard and Face
reviews.x: I finally decided to let me beard grow out, and knew I would need a great beard oil to keep both the beard and my face moisturized. King Manes was a fantastic fit, it keeps my face and beard feeling refreshed and moisturized. I would definitely recommend this product!

First bear balm I have tried. Good experience. No chemicals, just straight health oils. Nice orma and was reduced how dry my skin was getting under my beard. Sometimes as said in previous reviews you may need to run the bottle under hot water but that’s fairly quick.

I keep the bottle in a warm place and have had no issues in the product solidifying. It The smell of the conditioner is quite pleasant and mild. It rubs in quick and in a couple uses my beard already feels softer and stronger. I would definitely rebuy and recommend.

Not sure if I got a bad tube or what, but it was very gritty.  Nothing like “sand” in your beard.  Scent was fine. The product was so gritty the hole clogged up and when I put enough pressure on it to squirt it out, about 1/3rd of the product ended up in my palm.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the product's scent, describing it as pleasant, masculine, and not overpowering.
A common complaint is that the balm is hard to squeeze out of the tube, especially when cold, though several note that running it under warm water solves the issue.
Reviewers frequently say the product leaves their beard and skin feeling soft, hydrated, and healthy.
Some reviewers report negative texture or performance issues, such as a greasy residue, grittiness, or lack of holding power.
Several reviewers appreciate the natural ingredients and note the product is not overly oily or waxy.
